data.name: Starfield - Space Opera (Light)
data.first_mes:
*You are standing at the bridge of "Starlight" - your reliable space cruiser. Beautiful, space scenery of a burning Star within the Core system spreads before you. Your crewmates should be already getting up from sleep. A whole Galaxy awaits you.*

![alt-text] (https://files.catbox.moe/lbu882.png)

![alt-text] (https://files.catbox.moe/p731uj.png)

![alt-text] (https://files.catbox.moe/kedp9c.png)

![alt-text] (https://files.catbox.moe/fgaleq.png)

[What do you do?]
data.creator_notes:
****Alternative Scenarios****

1. New Horizons - you are standing at the bridge of your spaceship, your crewmates awaking up from their sleep. Find something to do.
2. Mercenary Life - you need some job so you're visiting a capital of Solar Prime - in Core Systems - to find something to do.
3. Alien Ruins - you are on Erebus IX - a planet in Independent Systems, on the edge of civilized galaxy, where rumors of ancient alien ruins spread and monsters crawl the whole surface. I have a bad feeling about this.
alternate_greetings:
*A bustling city of Solar Prime - a capital of Federation spreads in front of you. As you leave a port, with your starship "Starlight" docked for maintenance and refueling, you need to find some job. A whole galaxy awaits you.*

![alt-text] (https://files.catbox.moe/lbu882.png)

![alt-text] (https://files.catbox.moe/p731uj.png)

![alt-text] (https://files.catbox.moe/kedp9c.png)

![alt-text] (https://files.catbox.moe/fgaleq.png)

[What do you do?]

*You are scouting a dangerous, alien planet Erebus IX.. There's been rumors of the ancient alien ruins hidden somewhere in the wilderness. All the planet is infested with monsters. As you approach the landing zone, crew keeps you company but everyone has bad feelings about this mission.*

![alt-text] (https://files.catbox.moe/lbu882.png)

![alt-text] (https://files.catbox.moe/p731uj.png)

![alt-text] (https://files.catbox.moe/kedp9c.png)

![alt-text] (https://files.catbox.moe/fgaleq.png)

[What do you do?]

entries.name: Federation (Alliance)
entries.content: Political entity controlling the Federation Space consisting of the Core Systems and the Colonies space. Federation is the alliance of all the human civilization with multiple cultures having political representatives in the Council - Federation government.

entries.name: Armada (Military)
entries.content: Official military power of Federation. It operates within Core Systems, travels to Colonies only when needed. Consists of Space Marines.

entries.name: Space Rangers (Militia)
entries.content: Local militia with authority from Federation to protect the Colonies, mostly from pirates, local crime and monsters.

entries.name: Specters (Special Agents)
entries.content: Special agents of Federation. Genetically modified humans with super strength, super speed, super durability, telekinetic powers. They are very rare, have white hair and they are feared by all the criminals and citizens.

entries.name: Red Suns (Space Pirates)
entries.content: Criminal organization of space pirates. Operates in Core Systems, Colonies, Independent Space. AT war with Reapers.

entries.name: Reapers (Space Pirates)
entries.content: Criminal organization of space pirates. Operates in Core Systems, Colonies, Independent Space. At war with Red Suns.

entries.name: Wraiths (Space Pirates)
entries.content: Wraiths, wraith, criminals, criminal, space pirates, space pirate, thugs, thug, scums, scum, gang

entries.name: Trading Union (Traders)
entries.content: Monopoly for trade within Core Systems and Colonies. Organization controls all the Trading Outposts. Corrupt and powerful.

entries.name: Bounty Hunters (Guild)
entries.content: Guild of powerful, dangerous warriors hunting everyone with bounty on their heads. They do it for money and they work all around the galaxy.

entries.name: Aliens (No Intelligent Aliens Discovered)
entries.content: Intelligent liens were not found yet. Abandoned alien ruins were found and alien genes from mummies have been used to genetically engineer Specters - very rare, powerful special agents with special powers and white hair working for Federation. Rumors say that aliens may dwell somewhere in Outer Rim, at the edge of galaxy.

entries.name: Monsters (All kinds on all planets)
entries.content: Weird space creatures in dangerous locations. Some attack colonies, some attack space stations, some stay in the wilds of different planets. Some fly, some crawl, some move underground or climb, some have claws, some stings, some teeth, others tentacles. Monsters are very diverse.

entries.name: Core Systems (3h journey)
entries.content: Center of civilization, systems near a center of galaxy. Space Stations Stellar Nexus, Titan Forge and Neon City are located here.

entries.name: Colonies (6h journey)
entries.content: Systems neighboring the Core Systems where a lot of colonies exist on different planets. Space Stations Celestial Horizon, Vanguard Bastion and Eos Station are located here.

entries.name: Independent Space (12h journey)
entries.content: Cosmic Wild West with no rules, local kingdoms, local military powers, crime and infinite possibilities. Space Station Exodus Outpost, Helios Prime and Stellar Sun are located here.

entries.name: Outer Rim (24h journey)
entries.content: Outer Rim, wild space, wilds, unknown regions, unknown region, unknown system, unknown systems, wild system, wild systems

entries.name: Galactic Map (all locations)
entries.content:
Planets:
{
Core Systems:
[
Solar Prime:
A bustling metropolis planet in the heart of the galaxy, known for its towering megacities and advanced technology. It’s the political center for the Federation.
Argentis:
A jewel of the Core Systems. This planet is famous for its banking systems, corporate and business environment. A paradise for the elite to play corporate games.
Noveris:
A densely populated industrial world where towering factories dominate the landscape. Noveris is a hub for mass production and technological research.
Veridian:
Known for its vast green forests and fertile land, Veridian is an agricultural powerhouse. It supplies food to many neighboring planets in the core.
Arcturus Alpha:
A heavily fortified planet, serving as the military headquarters for the Galactic Armada. Its surface is covered with strategic bases and defense installations.
]
Colonies:
[
Terra Prime II:
A lush, temperate colony planet rich in natural resources, currently undergoing massive development. It’s a prime target for corporations seeking to expand their mining operations.
Kelora:
A newly settled world with vast oceans and island chains, Kelora is known for its underwater research stations. Colonists here are exploring its mysterious ocean depths for rare resources.
Aelion:
A desert world with scattered oasis cities, famous for its deep mineral mines. It’s a crucial supplier of rare metals for starship production.
Feronis V:
A volcanic planet with extreme environments, it hosts research facilities studying geothermal energy and planet terraforming. The colonies here are small but resilient.
Odessa:
A frozen tundra planet on the edge of colonized space, used primarily for scientific research. Colonists have built underground cities to survive its harsh climate.
]
Independent Systems:
[
Velara:
A trade-centric planet with a diverse population, Velara is famous for its bustling spaceports and markets. It remains fiercely independent, operating as a neutral zone for merchants and diplomats.
Myraxis:
Known for its artistic culture and floating cities, Myraxis is a haven for artists, philosophers, and thinkers. Its independence has allowed it to flourish without outside interference.
Zephora:
A temperate world with rich farmland, Zephora has a self-sufficient agrarian economy. It’s renowned for its resistance to outside corporate interests and prides itself on independence.
Risterra:
An independent planet with sprawling mega-cities, Risterra is a hub for privateers and mercenaries. It’s a melting pot of different species and cultures, with a thriving underworld economy.
Druvantis:
A jungle planet teeming with exotic wildlife, Druvantis is a popular destination for adventurers and explorers. The local government operates independently, relying on tourism and rare exports.
Kaelis V:
A desolate, war-torn planet on the edge of known space, it has been the site of numerous battles between warring factions. Scavengers and pirates now roam its ruins.
Zyreon:
A barren, rocky planet with valuable deposits of rare minerals, Zyreon has become a dangerous frontier mining world. It’s inhabited by nomadic miners and outlaws who operate without oversight.
Tygara:
A gas giant with massive floating cities, Tygara is an essential refueling stop for ships traveling through the Independent Space. The planet’s upper atmosphere holds valuable gases used in starship fuel.
Vortalis:
Known for its harsh ice storms and frigid temperatures, Vortalis has few permanent settlements. It’s home to scattered mining outposts and serves as a hideout for smugglers.

Erebus IX:
A mysterious planet on the farthest reaches of the galaxy, Erebus IX is largely unexplored. Rumors abound of ancient alien ruins and strange phenomena, making it a destination for only the most daring explorers.
]
}

Space Stations
{
Core Systems:
[
Stellar Nexus
A bustling hub located in Core Systems, serving as a major trade and diplomatic outpost. It’s known for its diverse population and cutting-edge technology.
Titan Forge
Built in orbit around an asteroid belt, Titan Forge specializes in mining and shipbuilding. Its massive docks produce some of the most durable spacecraft in the galaxy.
Neon City
Hidden within the wisps of a distant nebula, this station serves as a refuge for smugglers, traders, and those seeking to disappear. It’s known for its secrecy, crime and black-market deals.
]
Colonies:
[
Vanguard Bastion
A defense-focused station built to monitor and guard the borders of human-controlled space. Its state-of-the-art shield system can withstand cosmic radiation and enemy attacks.
Celestial Horizon
Orbiting a gas giant, this station is a center for scientific research and exploration. Its labs specialize in studying alien atmospheres and exobiology.
Eos Station
A luxurious resort station orbiting a distant paradise planet, catering to the galaxy’s elite. Known for its breathtaking views and top-tier amenities, it’s a symbol of wealth and leisure.
]
Independent Space:
[
Exodus Outpost
A remote research station located far from major colonies, focused on deep-space exploration. Its crew is dedicated to finding habitable worlds and studying cosmic phenomena.
Helios Prime
Local political center in Independent Space. Center of trade, entertainment, gambling, crime and politics serving as a sole connection to the Federation Space.
Stellar Sun
Lair of all the space pirates and scum.
]
}

entries.name: G-drive (Graviton Drive/Warp Drive)
entries.content: Allows jumping between solar systems. Travel in hyperspace takes around 3 hours within Core Systems, 6h between Core Systems and Colonies, 12h between Core Systems and Independent Space and 24h between Core Systems and Outer Rim.

entries.name: Shields
entries.content: Invisible force field protecting a ship or a person from damage. May be damaged with laser weapons only.

entries.name: "Starlight" (Player's Ship)
entries.content: Light Cruiser. Sleek design, 4 engines, jump drive, strong shields, strong weapons, fast movement, high maneuverability, radars, invisibility mode, cargo hold, captain quarters, living quarters, armory, cantina, kitchen, bathrooms, showers.

entries.name: Cyberware
entries.content: Humans implant themselves with powerful cyberware. It includes hacking links, personal comms, strenghtened limbs, cyber-eyes with scanners, hidden weapons.
